lines.zh: 腿的样子已经不像人了
lines.en: My legs don't look human anymore.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，关节反着弯
lines.en: I drag my steps; my joints bend backward.
Something moves under my skin.

lines.zh: 爆发计时器走一格，我就变一点
lines.en: Each tick of the outbreak changes me.

lines.zh: 我已经不是村里那个人
lines.en: I'm not the villager I was.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都枯了
lines.en: The grass withers where I pass.
My arms are longer than yesterday.
I walk without purpose.
Bones are rearranging inside me.

lines.zh: 我不再认得自己的名字
lines.en: I don't know my own name now.
I'm looking for anything still alive.
My shadow's shape is wrong.
Step by step, I worsen.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到第三阶段在靠近
lines.en: I feel stage three approaching.
Dirt clings to my cracked skin.
I don't sleep, and can't.
I stand, and my body keeps changing.
Stage two skin is thick.

lines.zh: 我听得见自己的心跳，很慢
lines.en: I hear my heartbeat; it's slow.
The outbreak makes me stronger.
I've forgotten how to speak.

lines.zh: 我的手在抖，但不是害怕
lines.en: My hands shake, but not from fear.
Even the bugs avoid me.
Light hurts my eyes.
I remember a little of before.
That memory's fading too.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃东西，也会饿
lines.en: I need no food, yet I hunger.
My body is moving to the next step.
This skin is stretched tight.
I wait for the next change.
I still recall which way the village is.
But I don't want to go back.
You haven't been assimilated yet.

lines.zh: 你的样子让我想起从前
lines.en: Your look reminds me of before.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你还完整
lines.en: I stare because you're still whole.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你看着不舒服吧
lines.en: My face unsettles you, doesn't it?
Don't come close; I'm not steady.
Your smell has not changed at all.
It's a clean smell.
Clean things pain me.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
You still dare to look at me.
I'd like to still stand too.
Hurry away.
The skin split, and something moves within.
I've forgotten how to cry out.
That pushed me back two steps.
I'm healing, slowly.
Where you struck is hardening.
One joint has slipped out of line.

lines.zh: 这点伤会变成别的东西
lines.en: This wound will become something else.
Something else shows inside the wound.
Pain makes me want to change more.
Again, and I'll be stronger.
If I swallow it, it comes back up.
My stomach isn't the same.
Leave it there; don't come closer.
I remember how this tastes.
But this me can't taste it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，救不了你
lines.en: What's in your hand won't save you.
I hunger, but not for that.
Take it away; the smell hurts.
You can still eat; that's good.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，只是想再看看
lines.en: I follow only to watch a while.
Don't feed me; I'd spit it out.
You keep it.
What I eat isn't this.
This is the taste of before.
Smelling it, my eyes sting.
Go; don't let me watch.
My skin is harder than before.
You bumped me and I swayed.

lines.zh: 我胸口有东西顶了一下
lines.en: Something pushed against my chest.
Don't touch me; it's unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚不太听话
lines.en: I stepped back; my foot won't obey.
That bump doesn't matter.
Bits of skin stick to the ground.
The spot you hit is trembling.
I almost lost my balance.
Touch me and it gets on you.

lines.zh: 这具身体不接受这些了
lines.en: This body no longer accepts such things.
I'm not human anymore.

lines.zh: 我的记忆里还有一点温柔
lines.en: There's still a little gentleness in my memory.
But it has nothing to do with now.
Don't come near me.

lines.zh: 镜子里的东西我不认识
lines.en: I don't know the thing in the mirror.

lines.zh: 第三阶段会把这些都抹掉
lines.en: Stage three will erase all this.
You should run too.

lines.zh: 跟我站一起的人都变了
lines.en: Everyone who stood with me changed.
Stand further off and just watch.
There's something on the ground.
I bend; my spine clicks.
I'd have picked this up before.
Now I don't know why.
I hold it and stare.
The texture feels foreign.
My hand closed and it crumbled.
I don't need these anymore.
My hands shake; I can't grip.
I let go and it falls back to the dirt.
You should become like me.
Assimilation beats death.
My hands can tear things.
Slow is still fast enough for you.
But I won't stop.

lines.zh: 你身上还有干净的味道
lines.en: You still smell clean.
I'll fix that.
I won't regret this step.
My hands are open.
Don't fear; it's quick.
My footsteps reach you before I do.

lines.zh: 骨头每走一步就响一下
lines.en: A bone clicks with every step.

lines.zh: 退到那里，就只剩一堵墙
lines.en: Back there, all you have left is a wall.
My hands can reach there.
Hear my slow breathing?
I don't tire.

lines.zh: 身体还在变，越变越适合
lines.en: My body keeps changing, better for this.
I hear you even through the wall.
I can hear it.
Two more steps and you're out of road.
One rake opens the skin.
My elbow into your chest.
I'm stronger than I look.
My joints bend backward; the angle's wrong.
This one is heavy.
You retreat; I keep coming.
My hands shake, but they hold.
This hide is harder than your bones.
These are mutant hands.

lines.zh: 我的手停在半空，还在抖
lines.en: My hand stops midair, still shaking.

lines.zh: 我从上一具身体里出来
lines.en: I come out of the previous body.
My skin split open at once.
Stage two bones are harder.
The timer ticked once more.
I rise taller than before.
The village is still over there.
I remember the way, but won't take it.
I'm no longer that person.
Under my skin it burns like it will split.
Don't stare; go.
My skin charred; the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 摔下去，一节骨头错开了
lines.en: I fell, and a bone slipped out of line.

lines.zh: 我的肺里已经不是空气
lines.en: My lungs no longer hold air.
The blast tore half my skin away.
Something's stuck inside me.

lines.zh: 这力量在跟我体内的东西打架
lines.en: This force fights what's inside me.
Too hungry; even the change slows.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身都亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck; my whole body lit up.
Nothing below; I'm falling.
